ProjectsSection.headline: Products we've built
ProjectsSection.subheadline: Each project covers the problem, what we built, and how it turned out.

elus-food.name: Elus Food
elus-food.summary: Turns the menu into posts and handles creation, scheduling, and publishing on Instagram, Threads, and X.
elus-food.challenge: Restaurants know they need to post often, but kitchen routines leave no time to create, review, and schedule content. The result is an idle profile or posts that don't show the real menu.
elus-food.built: An iOS and Android app and a web dashboard that import the menu, suggest posts when something relevant changes, and let the team review photo, caption, channels, and time before publishing. The AI works on the restaurant's own data, with the brand identity stored per location.
highlights: Menu imported from iFood, no typing
Ideas by text, audio, photo, or link become editable drafts
Calendar with the state of every post
Publishing to Instagram, Threads, and X

npslab.name: NPSLab
npslab.tagline: Customer surveys that turn into action
npslab.summary: NPS, CSAT, and CES surveys collected by QR code, tablet, or link, with real-time alerts and a multi-store view.
npslab.challenge: Stores and chains rarely hear from customers, and when they do, they find problems too late. Survey tools tend to be expensive and built for the desktop, not for whoever is at the counter.
npslab.built: An iPhone and Android app and a web dashboard that set up a survey in minutes, collect answers by QR code, kiosk-mode tablet, link, or WhatsApp, and notify the manager's phone as soon as a review arrives. Chains and franchises compare locations in a ranking.
highlights: NPS, CSAT, and CES in one tool
Collection by QR code, kiosk, link, or WhatsApp
In-app subscriptions on the App Store and Google Play

elus.name: Elus
elus.tagline: Content for every channel, in your brand's voice
elus.summary: A platform that creates articles, posts, and creatives with AI and publishes to Instagram, X, Threads, LinkedIn, and the brand's blog.
elus.challenge: Marketing teams and agencies need to keep a blog and social channels active across languages, always in the same voice. Doing it by hand takes the whole team.
elus.built: A multi-tenant web platform with a copilot that knows the brand's strategy, generates content in 50+ languages, and publishes straight to the connected channels in a single flow.
highlights: Articles, posts, and creatives in the brand's voice
Publishing to Instagram, X, Threads, LinkedIn, and blog
Interface in English, Portuguese, and Spanish
Built for agencies and marketing teams

paina.name: Instituto Paina
paina.tagline: Website, courses, and the PAINA PEI platform
paina.summary: The digital ecosystem of Instituto de Educação Paina: institutional website, course platform, and PAINA PEI, for individualized education planning.
paina.challenge: Teachers and schools working in special education must record case studies, Individualized Education Plans, and progress evidence, usually in scattered documents with sensitive data moving around without control.
paina.built: The institutional website, the course platform, and PAINA PEI: a collaborative web and mobile product for case studies, IEPs, and specialized support plans, with school–family collaboration, versioned and auditable plans, and restricted access to sensitive data.
highlights: Case study, IEP, and support plan in one flow
One account for website, courses, and PEI

sites.name: ConectaLab Sites
sites.tagline: A professional website ready in hours
sites.summary: Websites for freelancers, service providers, and small businesses, with booking, WhatsApp, and local SEO included.
sites.challenge: Professionals and small businesses are searched for on Google every day, but many have no website or one that brings no contact. A custom site usually takes weeks and costs a lot.
sites.built: A website production line: templates by specialty, copy and photos based on the professional's profile, and publishing in hours, with a WhatsApp button, booking, and local SEO.
highlights: Templates by specialty, such as health and law
A ready-made demo for every prospect
Landing pages for events and launches

digitocrm.name: DigitoCRM
digitocrm.tagline: CRM with AI agents handling customer service
digitocrm.summary: A multi-tenant CRM with a sales pipeline, AI agents for customer service, scheduling, and a chat widget for websites.
digitocrm.challenge: Small and mid-sized businesses lose leads between first contact and sale: messages scatter, nobody replies after hours, and the pipeline lives in the salesperson's head.
digitocrm.built: A multi-tenant web CRM with a kanban pipeline, AI agents that answer and schedule, and a chat widget any website can embed, including the sites of our other products.

Process.headline: From problem to product in production
Process.subheadline: The same process we use for our own products, applied to yours.

steps.title: Understand the problem
steps.body: We start with the day-to-day of whoever will use it: what gets stuck, what's expensive, and what can be measured.

steps.title: Design the product
steps.body: Flows, screens, and a prototype before code, to validate early what's worth building.

steps.title: Build
steps.body: iOS and Android apps, web systems, and integrations, delivered in stages you can see working.

steps.title: Launch and operate
steps.body: App store publishing, payments, metrics, and continuous improvement once the product is live.

capabilities: App Store and Google Play publishing
Integrations with iFood, social networks, and WhatsApp

About.headline: Who's behind the studio
About.name: Felipe Castro
About.photo_alt: Photo of Felipe Castro, founder of CONECTA LAB
bio: I graduated from UFSM, hold an MBA from FGV, and took advanced courses at ESPM and MIT, on topics ranging from marketing to agentic artificial intelligence.
I'm also an entrepreneur in real estate, foodservice, and SaaS. Knowing these businesses from the inside, I start every project with the problem, not the technology.
CONECTA LAB is small on purpose: I follow every project end to end, from product design to publishing and running it in production. The products in this portfolio were built this way.
